title: Cause Mix Concentration Risk
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=volunteer:shift
| stats sum(hours) as hours by cause
| eventstats sum(hours) as total_hours
| eval cause_share_pct=round(100*hours/total_hours,1)
| sort - cause_share_pct
description: Shows whether your volunteering is balanced across causes or concentrated heavily into one area.
value: Concentration is not always bad, but seeing it clearly helps decide whether your commitments reflect your intent.
implementation: Aggregate volunteered hours by cause and calculate each cause's share of total hours.
visualization: Pie chart of volunteer hour share by cause.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how concentrated your volunteering has become in one cause versus spread across several.
